section_5_to_7s_occlusion.observed: Player sprite partially concealed behind Boss Commander Greatshield and torso
section_5_to_7s_occlusion.root_cause: Boss _execute_triple_cleave() lunged forward at 4.2m/s regardless of distance to player. Combined with _prevent_player_pushing() only being called during Pattern.CHASE and having a narrow min_x of 1.70m, horizontal separation collapsed to 1.18m (below combined sprite span of 1.52m). Because boss depth Z (-1.55m) was slightly closer to camera than player Z (-1.60m), the larger boss sprite drew over the hero silhouette.
section_5_to_7s_occlusion.fix: Enforced min_x >= 2.05m clearance in both Boss and Player mutual pushback. Clamped boss cleave lunge when within 2.30m melee range so boss does not overshoot into player silhouette. Result: 100% silhouette visibility with 0 critical overlaps.

section_9_to_11s_hero_collapse.observed: Hero shown collapsed/fallen in death state at ~10.5s while boss is still alive
section_9_to_11s_hero_collapse.root_cause: In the stress fixture script (record_boss_lane_alignment.gd), Step 5 (BOTTOM_LANE_DUEL) was programmed to only issue attack inputs (Input.action_press('attack')) without any guard, parry, or dodge inputs. The boss executed legitimate combat cleaves dealing 2 unmitigated damage per hit. The player took 5 hits over 10.5 seconds, reducing HP from 9 to 0 (HP: 0/9 clearly visible in the top-left UI HUD at 10.5s). Upon HP reaching 0, the player controller cleanly executed start_death() and played the fallen death animation as intended by the engine state machine. It was NOT an unhandled exception, physics bug, or infinite state lock.
section_9_to_11s_hero_collapse.verification: Defeat and retry verified in v3_024_r4_defeat_retry_verification.gd: upon HP reaching 0, player enters State.DEAD, defeat overlay displays RETRY STAGE button, and clicking Retry cleanly re-instantiates Stage 1 with full HP (9/9) and zero dangling state.
